title: TimeTrack client API: GET /api/time-track/v1/me/capabilities (200), v1 (TimeTrack 2.4)
description: The client modules (device-flow scope families) the token's person may use now, in the context the request names. Called with a token of any registered family. Errors use the client API error shape {error, message}; a request of a revoked module elsewhere answers 403 {error: module_forbidden, message, module}.

scopeFamily.description: Scope family of the calling token.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the calling token.

context.description: Context key the request named (null without a context header or a context policy).

modules.description: Family key => whether the person may use the module now. time, chat and tasks are always present (false while not registered).

grantableScopes.description: For each usable family, the scope values a device may ask for in the device flow.
